sponsors.meta.title: Sponsors - TypeWhisper
sponsors.meta.description: Support TypeWhisper as an open-source funder or ecosystem partner. Curated sponsorship keeps the project independent, local-first, and open.
sponsors.hero.title: Help keep TypeWhisper independent, local-first, and open.
sponsors.hero.subtitle: We work with sponsors who fit the project: open source funders, privacy-minded AI and ML teams, developer tools, accessibility projects, and productivity products that make sense for TypeWhisper users.
sponsors.models.title: Two ways to support the project.
sponsors.models.subtitle: Sponsorship is separate from commercial licensing. It funds the project and can include clear public recognition, but it does not grant alternative license terms, support SLAs, or unmarked recommendations.
sponsors.model.oss.title: OSS funders
sponsors.model.oss.description: Companies or individuals who want TypeWhisper to stay open, sustainable, and useful without asking for product placement.
sponsors.model.ecosystem.title: Ecosystem partners
sponsors.model.ecosystem.description: AI, speech, productivity, accessibility, or developer-tool teams whose products genuinely fit TypeWhisper workflows.
sponsors.placement.title: This is where a sponsor would appear.
sponsors.placement.subtitle: Approved sponsors are listed on this page in a compact, clearly labeled block. The listing is visible, but it stays separate from licensing, downloads, and product recommendations.
sponsors.placement.detail.page: Shown on the public sponsors page with name, short description, and link
sponsors.placement.detail.logo: Optional logo slot when the sponsor provides a suitable asset
sponsors.placement.detail.label: Marked as a sponsor or ecosystem partner, not presented as an editorial recommendation
sponsors.placement.exampleDescription: A short, plain-English description of why this sponsor fits TypeWhisper users and the local-first, open-source direction of the project.
sponsors.criteria.title: What fits.
sponsors.criteria.subtitle: The bar is simple: sponsorship should make TypeWhisper more sustainable without making the product less trustworthy.
sponsors.criteria.privacy: Privacy, local-first computing, or user control
sponsors.criteria.opensource: Open source, open models, or transparent developer infrastructure
sponsors.criteria.ai: AI, ML, speech, transcription, or automation tools that fit real TypeWhisper workflows
sponsors.criteria.accessibility: Accessibility, productivity, writing, notes, or communication tools
sponsors.visibility.title: Visibility without advertising pressure.
sponsors.visibility.subtitle: Sponsors can be visible, but the product stays honest. No in-app advertising, no hidden endorsements, and no paid placement in core user flows.
sponsors.visibility.website: Website mention with name, link, and optional logo
sponsors.visibility.context: Possible future ecosystem mentions only where they are relevant and clearly labeled
sponsors.visibility.noAds: No in-app ads, popups, or unmarked recommendations
sponsors.visibility.noLicense: No license rights, procurement terms, or support SLAs through sponsorship
sponsors.current.title: Current sponsors
sponsors.cta.title: Interested in supporting TypeWhisper?
sponsors.cta.subtitle: Send a short note with who you are, what you build, and why it fits TypeWhisper. We review sponsorships manually before listing anyone.
